claims: The White Lotus Season 4 will take place in France.
Filming for The White Lotus Season 4 runs from April to October 2026.
The White Lotus Season 4 targets a 2027 release date.

As of March 2026, the cast of The White Lotus Season 4 includes Helena Bonham Carter, Rosie Perez, Heather Graham, Vincent Cassel, Steve Coogan, Max Greenfield, Kumail Nanjiani, Ari Graynor, Chris Messina, Alexander Ludwig, Chloe Bennet, Sandra Bernhard, AJ Michalka, Nadia Tereszkiewicz, Corentin Fila, Caleb Jonte Edwards, Marissa Long, Dylan Ennis, Charlie Hall, Jarrad Paul, Frida Gustavsson, Tobias Santelmann, Ben Schnetzer, Laura Smet.
Mike White continues to write and direct The White Lotus.
The White Lotus is produced for HBO.
The third season of The White Lotus is scheduled to premiere in 2025.
